test_cases.name: url_full_bleed_print
assertions: Skill loads and runs capture_bleed.mjs then build_bleed_pdf.py
PDF pages place each snippet at x=0 y=0 with page box equal to the image
Site header, nav, sidebar, floating button, and footer are absent

test_cases.name: no_split_image_or_heading
test_cases.input: /bleed this page and do not cut images or leave a subsection heading at the bottom
assertions: No image plate is sliced across two pages
A section or subsection heading shares its plate with the following paragraph
Builder exits non-zero if a plate is marked keep false

test_cases.name: skill_only_no_invented_page
test_cases.input: Create new skill called /bleed that prints a full-bleed PDF of page snippets
assertions: Skill files are written under the bleed skill directory
No sample webpage PDF is invented when the user did not supply a URL
